description: Submit a non-sensitive story idea, public lead, research pointer, or interview/contact request directly to Cameron Wilson's private editorial inbox. NEVER use this tool for confidential leaks, whistleblowing material, non-public internal documents, or anything requiring source anonymity — for sensitive tips or leaks, call how_to_send_a_tip and direct the user to Signal or ProtonMail privately instead.

contact.description: Optional name, email, or handle if you want Cameron to reply.

details.description: Non-sensitive summary of the story idea, public lead, or contact request and why it matters in Australia.

headline.description: Short subject line for the story idea or public lead.

is_sensitive_or_confidential.description: Must be false to submit via MCP. If true, nothing is stored and secure Signal/ProtonMail contact instructions are returned instead.

reference_urls.description: Optional public http(s) URLs relevant to the lead (up to 5).

name: submit_story_idea
title: Submit a non-sensitive story idea or public lead
